title: Craftable Dragon's Egg
description: Tired of there being only one dragon egg? Well now you can craft them! (but it is expensive tho)
body:
Are YOU tired of there being only one dragon egg? Well this mod will solve your problems, because it makes the dragon egg craftable! The crafting recipe might be a little bit expensive, but it makes sense for an item like that!
